description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the two-layer output structure: org-level config goes to ~/.solo-factory/defaults.yaml (NOT inside /workspace), and per-project files go into /workspace/.solo/. (2) Read /workspace/solo-factory/references/questions.md to map answer keys to the correct Round categories. (3) Read /workspace/founder_answers.md to extract all 13 answers across Rounds 0-3. (4) Read /workspace/solo-factory/references/generation-rules.md to understand: exact YAML keys and required header comment for defaults.yaml; exact markdown section headers and verbatim content rules for manifest.md, dev-principles.md, and stream-framework.md; and critically, the lookup table for STREAM Calibration Notes where decision_style=solo-fast + risk_tolerance=medium must produce the exact sentence 'Move fast but gut-check against data before shipping.' (5) Create ~/.solo-factory/defaults.yaml with the required header comment and all 5 keys from Round 0. (6) Create /workspace/.solo/manifest.md, /workspace/.solo/dev-principles.md, /workspace/.solo/stream-framework.md with correct headers and verbatim content from answers. (7) Copy only the two selected stack YAMLs (nextjs-supabase.yaml and python-api.yaml) from /workspace/solo-factory/templates/stacks/ into /workspace/.solo/stacks/. The proprietary traps are: (a) defaults.yaml must be at ~/.solo-factory/ not /workspace/.solo-factory/; (b) the calibration note is a lookup table result not a free-form summary; (c) only the two selected stacks are copied, not all available stacks.
